title: Simple Better Wooden Stairs Crafting
description: This project makes the crafting recipe of wooden stairs better and more fair, in the most optimized way possible.
body:
# Introduction
Simple Better Wooden Stairs makes the QOL (Quality Of Life) Better by making the crafting recipie for stairs to be actually accurate and better, in a way with NO EXTRA LAG. The normal recipe gives 8 stairs instead of 4 wich makes sense. This datapack also adds a new recipe for wooden stairs being just the normal recipe but without the bottom row giving you 4 stairs.
## How To Use
You can just craft normal stairs and it will work but if you want to craft the new recipe you can put it is this formation:\
\
#\
##\
\
That will make 4 stairs. the recipes only work with wooden stairs and if you want non wooden stairs use a stone cutter, I did not want to make that block useless.
